doc.title: Johnny Varro interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001

title: Spiegel Willcox and his daughter
summary: Greetings from Willcox's daughter and the near match-up at Nick's.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: I’m sending greetings from Cynthia Willcox. Spiegel’s daughter?
You probably wonder — you played with him a number of times I guess?

Oh he used to come into Nick’s back in the 50s, the early 50s. Spiegel used to come in and sit in and Cindy would be with him. In fact there was a little thing going there with Spiegel and Phil Napoleon trying to match me and Cindy, and Cynthia together.
We are close to the same age, I think she’s a little younger.
But it never materialized. She’s was living in Upstate New York and she’s adorable though. I like her very much. She’s a good gal.
